children: Shares of Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Ltd. will be in focus on Friday, November 6, after the company reported its September quarter (Q2FY27) results, with revenue exceeding analyst estimates, while net profit and EBITDA declined sharply year-on-year.
The pharmaceutical company reported a 56.7% year-on-year decline in consolidated net profit to ₹264 crore, compared with ₹610 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
Revenue fell 29.8% to ₹4,247.3 crore from ₹6,046.8 crore a year ago. However, the topline figure was better than estimates.
EBITDA declined 63.4% year-on-year to ₹864 crore, compared with ₹2,360 crore in the year-ago period. The EBITDA margin contracted to 20% from 39% a year earlier, in line with expectations.

Glenmark's India business reported revenue of ₹1,327.4 crore, up 704.2% from ₹165.1 crore in the year-ago quarter. However, on a like-for-like basis, the company's India formulation business recorded year-on-year growth of around 14% in Q2FY27.

Revenue from North America declined 72.9% to ₹1,208.9 crore from ₹4,465.6 crore in the corresponding quarter last year. In dollar terms, US sales stood at $126.6 million, above the estimated $105 million, but down from $516.7 million a year ago.

The company said North American revenue for Q2FY27 included the recognition of deferred out-licensing income for ISB 2001. Excluding this, the core business in the region recorded year-on-year growth of 31%.

Meanwhile, revenue from Europe increased 6.2% to ₹792 crore from ₹746 crore in the year-ago period. Emerging Markets (EM) revenue rose 33.2% to ₹876.9 crore, compared with ₹658.5 crore a year earlier.
Shares of Glenmark Pharmaceuticals settled 0.91% lower at ₹2,481.80 on Thursday, November 5. The stock has gained over 22% so far in 2026.

title: Glenmark Pharma shares will react to better-than-expected US sales in Q2, 14% growth in India biz
